messages:
jamal: Heads up — saw a spike in p95 for paged-attn on an fp8 model in prod a few mins ago. Rolling traffic off that variant. Logs + quick profile below. :warning:

jamal: nsys snapshot (trimmed):
```
Kernel: softmax_fp8_paged  | calls: 14 | avg ms: 1.8 -> 5.6 (today)
Fallbacks to generic_softmax     | calls: 42 | avg ms: 3.0
KV cache miss ratio up ~12% on affected pods
Exp overflow counters incrementing sporadically
```

maria: which model & batch distribution? seq lens?

jamal: model: rdw-internal/ppq-7b-fp8, traffic pattern: many short chats (seq 64-512) but occasional long contexts (2k-4k) due to user sessions. Batches small (1-4).

alex: can you paste the kernel_selector log? curious if we switched kernels because of seq_len or kv-paged flag

jamal: pasted selector lines:
```python
# kernel_selector heuristics (excerpt)
if kv_paged:
    preferred = "paged_fused"
elif dtype == "fp8" and seq_len > 1024:
    preferred = "flashx_stable"
else:
    preferred = "flash_attn_v2"
```
Selector chose paged_fused on the long requests, but we observed paged_fused softmax microkernel producing large exp values that then triggered numeric clamping & fallback in runtime.

sophie: hmm. we saw a similar fp8 softmax jitter in staging last month — clamp threshold was too aggressive for some quant params. Might be a quant calibr mismatch + paged memory reordering.

riley: KV cache eviction spike? that could explain miss ratio rising and extra page faults pushing us into slower code-paths

jamal: KV snapshot from one host:
```
KV entries: 1.2M
Active pages: 18k -> 22k (during spike)
Page faults/sec: 320 -> 980
Kernel fallback reason: numeric_guardrail (softmax overflow)
```

alex: NV counters from a repro run (local microbench):
```
softmax_fp8_paged: L2 hit drop, warp divergence up, FP_EXPOVERFLOW++ (counter 0x3b)
flashx_stable: no overflow, slightly higher scratch mem use but lower p95
```

maria: so paged_fused is triggering exp overflow in fp8 mantissa range, causing runtime to clamp and then fall back to safe path => perf reg. any quick mitigation besides rollback?

sophie: quick patch idea: softmax pre-normalize clamp for fp8 path + a tiny epsilon increase in the exp input range. patch sketch:
```c++
// in softmax_fp8_paged kernel launcher
float maxv = reduce_max(qk);
float scaled = qk - maxv;
// extra safety for fp8 edgecases
scaled = clamp(scaled, -64.0f, +64.0f); // tighten range a bit
scaled += 1e-4f;
```
Shouldn't cost much and avoids overflow for the degenerate cases. can roll as canary.

jamal: trying a canary build now with clamp; will route 5% traffic. also increasing batch packing threshold to prefer flashx_stable for dtype==fp8 & batch_size <=4 to avoid tiny-batch pathological behaviour.

perf-bot: uploaded trace gist: https://perf/reports/2791122334 (uploaded) :eyes:

alex: nice. i'll run a controlled microbench across seq lens [64,256,1024,2048,4096] comparing flash_attn_v2, paged_fused, flashx_stable with fp8 quant params. will include nsys timelines and heap/pf stats.

riley: also add a test that simulates many short chats with occasional long context in same session — that's the mix that surfaced this.
notes: action-items: sophie lands softmax clamp canary; alex runs microbench; jamal monitors canary & KV pages; rollback already applied to prod variant. thread owner: jamal
